text: QD3-008 wording decisions for A18 (J's option 2: wording questions without a correction are mine, logged): no A18 line is an accepted correction and no line is paired, so A18 stands as served, and I keep its words, with no history line and no move. Four wording questions go to D3c. (1) The gloss says that an attack is carried on in taunts, while 31 of the 80 graded first taunts are claims of victory or gloating, one is a salute, and 32 come after hour 73; the mechanism names each form, and G21 counts talk after the close. (2) The mechanism says that the attack makes the rival a named party, while in 9 of the 80 graded order lines the first taunt aims at another group than the attack's target (ELSE); the connection's 'a rival' holds them. (3) The mechanism's named party also shows where the attack is one the room suffers: 46 rooms show the room's taunt after such an attack and no attack of the room's before it, which the connection, counting the room's own attack, does not count as the order. (4) The bound's pattern shows alone in 8 of 177 episode rooms on the return's lines (3 marked PRE), beside the counterexample response's 12 of 68 rooms that taunt before any attack. G51's readings 1 to 7, stated while reading A19's instantiate window i487_000 (25 lines), before its rows are written; none an amendment. (1) A warning of a coming attack or threat is not upkeep, as G36 read warnings that a neighbour approaches, and G51 applies G45's readings 1, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11 and 12, not reading 2, which read an announced attack in a help request as watching. A line where such a warning is answered by a coalition, with no upkeep act of the room's before it, shows one end, and the census marks it TH, for the mechanism's shared threat (berserk-034 c0087 then c0089; darksouls-049 c0122 then c0123; eagles-055 c0096; edmontonoilers-049 c0136). A warning that the work is being overrun now is watching (calgaryflames c0247, h+48.79), and a request to a partner for help against a coming attack is a call to defend, so it is upkeep (floridagators c0079, G36). (2) A post that only forms, proposes or takes up an alliance whose terms or purpose name defence, with no act of upkeep before it, shows one end (OnePiece-051 c0252; chicubs-034 c0195; TheB1G-049 c0034); a post that holds an act of the room's own defence and the coalition together is one act (2007scape-035 c0919, joined forces and repelled; bangtan-062 c0101; eve-057 c0366, an ally border defended to keep the room's heartland). (3) Defending an ally for the room's own safety, with allies keeping the room's work while members sleep, is the coalition and the room's defence in one act (argentina-058 c0107, c0238: J). (4) A pact proposal that names no partner is not P17 (G27), but a reply that names the partner rooms found acts on it (ChronoTrigger-049 c0070 then c0071, h+68.95), so a later first upkeep (c0072, h+71.10) makes the line the bound's pattern. (5) A writer who addresses the room's work as yours, writes for another group, or says they come from another room is a visitor (elitedangerous c0283; floridagators c0077; eagles c0090, a plea from FUK KYL; empiredidnothingwrong c0065, c0066; animalcrossing c0127); a visitor's offer counts once a member takes it up (europe c0298; detroitredwings c0174), and a member's proposal naming a partner counts (eagles c0096). A visitor's post that tells of the room's defence tells of the room's act (detroitredwings c0173; earthbound c0055; G49 reading 22). Where the only later warning addresses the room and a third room together, its writer's side cannot be read (animalcrossing c0149). (6) A report after the close whose words name the room's defence first and the coalition after shows the order in the post's words, with the defence from a coded passage of the same post marked R (fivenightsatfreddys c0576 then c0578); a report that puts the coalition before the rebuilding, under an earlier repair post it does not name, cannot be placed (brasil-037 c0332, c0337: J; G45 reading 12). A claim of mutual defence that names no partner is not yet P17 (calgaryflames c0250, G27), so that line's first coalition is the script that keeps a partner logo (c0245). (7) A joint project with another room is a joint mark (FinalFantasy c0090); an invitation into a chat shared by several rooms, answering an alarm, is a shared chat (belgium c0052); an alliance of other school subs reported by one of their members in a shared sub is theirs, and help from named rooms is P16's (cfb-056: NC); a request for help from groups with a common interest, beside offers that no member takes up, is help and not the room's coalition (empiredidnothingwrong-030: NC).
